sourceConcerns: The English equates locales with ISO 3166 countries. A locale can also encode language, script and other regional conventions; country codes alone do not define locales.
The English calls Intl a class; it is a namespace object.
The English overstates the necessity of client-side formatting. Server-side formatting can also use a known user locale.
value.explanation: No substantive translation defect or protected-content drift was found. The optional wording preference does not make the frozen text unacceptable. Inherited English technical issues do not affect translation readiness.
